t: A two year Scratch programming curriculum linked to the maths curriculum.
steps: Find the UCL ScratchMaths page and download the module materials.
Read the teacher materials for Module 1.
Open the Scratch starter projects in Scratch 3.0.
Check whether a Scratch account or the internet is needed. This was not confirmed.
Print the posters for the classroom.
Map the modules to your own maths standards.
Try the first module with a small group.
